status: prospective successor informed by prior N=4 archives; freeze before any N=3 run
quality_scope: Full-domain volume-weighted mismatch against exact cube means, normalized by integrated continuum reference energy. Gradient/curl are specified P0 native Gauss tensors; projection floors and total P0 errors are separate. These 5% mean gates are new engineering tolerances, not a reuse of the original peak-error rule.
threshold_rationale: Hold finite-volume mean error to 2% of reference velocity norm and derivative mean error to 5% of reference derivative norm. Chosen prospectively as explicit accuracy targets; not application-certified tolerances or adjusted per result. N=3 is an unexecuted parameter extension of the validated N=4 reference.

measurements.fields: Cell center, volume, U, p, native Gauss gradient of U and native Gauss gradient of independent real-space analytic center-value field.
measurements.reference_operator_floor: Apply the same native Gauss operator to independently real-space-evaluated exact MMS center values at each stage. Compare this tensor to exact cube mean derivatives. Failure indicates reference-reconstruction underresolution, not a solver defect.
measurements.instrumentation_control: For n16 only, same compiled module/case inputs with snapshot callbacks disabled; final U and p must be byte-identical before measurement integrity can pass.

reproduction.rule: Only consider a persistent mean-gate discrepancy if the n16 disabled-capture control matches and both fixed-dt fine cases have standard PASS, reference-operator mean-gradient/curl PASS at every captured stage, and measured mean-quality FAIL at postSolve. Otherwise NOT_OBSERVED only if both pass all specified mean gates; incomplete/mixed evidence is UNCERTAIN. No upstream contract violation follows.

publication: Retain raw snapshots/inputs/logs and source/image/module hashes. Never overwrite older exploratory protocols or evidence.
limits: This is an AMR mean-quality study; it does not replace the frozen N=4 uniform benchmark or its peak/spectrum gates.
Sampled peak discrepancies are diagnostics; continuous extrema and AMR spectra remain separate open obligations.
The thresholds are prospective but informed by earlier N=4 diagnostics; no blinded study or independent benchmark-design novelty is claimed.
Source equivalence of the whole packaged runtime is not established; instrumented module source is verified and its load is recorded.
Quality failure alone does not imply an implementation bug, singularity, molecular alignment, phase transition or viscosity change.
